info.title: Bunkarr API
info.description: Bunkarr REST API. Authenticate with the API key from Settings > General in the X-Api-Key header (or the apikey query parameter), or with a login session cookie. Errors are {"message": "..."}: 400 invalid input, 401 not authenticated, 403 refused (a cross-site browser request, an action that needs a login session, a directory Bunkarr cannot read), 404 unknown id, 409 conflict with the current state (including safety refusals that need a confirmation or a mounted share), 502 Plex failed, 503 unavailable (the backup routes of a server without backup services, or a request stopped as the server shuts down), 500 anything else. Secrets (Plex tokens, Apprise URLs) are write-only. Job-starting endpoints answer 202 with the queued Job. Sizes are bytes, times RFC 3339.

JobParams.description: What a job works on; zero values are left out.

allowChanges.description: Run the changes the mass-change guard would hold (S10b).

phase.description: scanning, planning, copying, verifying, backing-up, finishing

stats.description: Runner-specific counters, e.g. sync: filesPlanned, filesCopied, filesUpdated, filesMoved, filesAdopted, filesLinked, filesRetained, filesDisplaced, filesHeld, filesFailed, filesSkipped, bytesPlanned, bytesCopied, durationMs.

Item.description: One planned unit of work of a job (a dry run's items are its preview).

detail.description: Runner-specific: source path, temp path, link target, reason.

ItemPage.description: One page of a job's items, in plan order.

cron.description: 5-field cron expression or @hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly, in the container's time zone; "" means none.

blockedReason.description: Why the scheduler refuses this schedule's jobs, e.g. 'destination "UNAS" is disabled' (its destination or Plex server is disabled; Run now answers 409 too); empty when they can run

plex.description: Path prefix as Plex sees it

local.description: The same folder as Bunkarr sees it

PlexBackup.description: The scheduled Plex DB backup (managed as a plexdb_backup schedule).

dataPath.description: The Plex Media Server data directory mounted into Bunkarr (read-only)

hasApiKey.description: The API key (Plex token) itself is never returned.

IntegrationInput.description: type is required on create and cannot change.

url.description: http(s) base URL without credentials, query or fragment

apiKey.description: Write-only. Empty or missing on update keeps the stored key.

clearApiKey.description: Update only: remove the stored key.

settings.description: PlexSettings for Plex integrations; missing on update keeps them.

type.description: Required unless id is given (then it defaults to the saved integration's type)

id.description: A saved integration whose stored key is used when apiKey is empty (0: none)

localPath.description: As Bunkarr sees it through the path mappings; "" when no mapping applies

destinationId.description: 0 or missing: the integration's backup destination

fsType.description: Recorded by the first successful scan after the source was saved

destFolder.description: Empty: create derives it from the name, update keeps it. Immutable once backed up (409).

path.description: The resolved path that would be stored

CatalogFilePage.description: One page of a source's catalog, by relative path.

truncated.description: More than 10000 subdirectories; the first ones are listed

Capabilities.description: What the destination probe found (design section 3).

unstableInodes.description: Inode numbers do not tell whether two names at the destination are one file: a hardlinked name (or another spelling on a case-insensitive destination) stats with other numbers than the name it is one file with, as on a CIFS mount with noserverino. Bunkarr then compares such names by content. A sync, verify or retention job that is not a dry run checks this again before it first compares two names and stores a change.

probeVersion.description: Version of the probe that found these capabilities (currently 1). 0 or missing: an older probe that did not check unstableInodes; the next sync, verify or retention job that is not a dry run probes the destination again, and until then inode numbers are not trusted.

DestinationSettings.description: Missing or zero values take the defaults.

Retention.description: Missing or zero values take the defaults (30, 14, 8).

lastJob.description: The newest job of any type that worked on the destination (sync, verify, retention, Plex DB backup)

lastSync.description: The newest sync of the destination (queued, running or finished; previews excluded): its last sync status. null before the first sync

DestinationInput.description: Create: name and target are required. Update: empty or missing fields keep the stored values.

target.description: Absolute path of the mounted share; it must exist. Cannot change after creation.

schedule.description: Sync schedule. Create: missing means none. Update: missing keeps it. {cron: "", enabled: false} removes it.

verifySchedule.description: Verify schedule. Create: missing means 0 5 * * 0 (weekly, Sunday 05:00). Update: missing keeps it.

attach.description: Create only: adopt the existing .bunkarr/destination.json marker (S3).

allowLocal.description: Create only: accept a target on a local filesystem (S3).

dryRun.description: Scan, plan and guard only; nothing is written (S9)

allowChanges.description: Run changes the mass-change guard holds (S10b)

dryRun.description: Queue a dry run (a preview): nothing is written or deleted (S9)

path.description: Version directory relative to the target

configKey.description: Apprise stateful mode; "" means stateless with the stored URLs

hasUrls.description: The Apprise URLs themselves are never returned.

urls.description: Write-only Apprise URLs (comma or space separated); empty on update keeps the stored ones.

NotificationTest.description: A notification form (apiUrl and urls or configKey required) or just the id of a saved notification.

id.description: A saved notification: empty urls use its stored URLs; an id without apiUrl tests it as saved.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with the current state (the message says why)

BadGateway.description: Plex answered badly or not at all

ServiceUnavailable.description: No backup services are configured on this server, or the request was stopped (the server is shutting down)

put.description: Changing the URL requires the token again (apiKey) or clearApiKey: a stored token is only sent to the URL it was saved with; otherwise 400.

Check whether a path can be a source (reads only its top-level listing)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the relative path

get.summary: List the subdirectories of a path for the path picker (read-only, directories only)

403.description: The directory is not readable by Bunkarr's user (check PUID/PGID and the permissions)

post.summary: Add a destination: checks and probes the target and writes its marker (S3); creates its schedules
post.description: A target that already holds a marker needs attach (409 otherwise); a target on a local filesystem needs allowLocal (400 otherwise).

post.summary: Check a target before creating a destination (writes nothing)

put.summary: Update a destination and its schedules (the target cannot change)

delete.summary: Forget a destination and its schedules; the backup data at the target is never touched

post.summary: Check a destination: marker, filesystem, free space; re-runs the capability probe
Sync the destination's sources now (dryRun: preview only)

202.description: The queued job (an identical queued job is returned instead of a new one)
The queued job (an identical queued job is returned instead of a new one)

get.summary: Plex database versions stored at the destination, newest first
List jobs (active: queue order; finished: most recent first)
Get a job (running jobs with live progress)

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job

200.description: The job as it is now

get.summary: A job's items (a dry run's preview)
Item counts and bytes by action and status
A job's log lines, oldest first
List schedules with their next run

put.summary: Change a schedule's cron expression or enabled flag

post.description: Queues the schedule's job with trigger manual, also when the schedule is disabled. With dryRun it queues a dry run instead (the Preview of System → Tasks): nothing is written or deleted, the job's items show what a run would do (a retention preview queues one dry-run retention job per enabled destination, whose expire items are the retained files a run would delete), and it is not recorded as a run of the schedule (lastRunAt).

202.description: The queued job (an identical queued job is returned instead of a new one)

409.description: The schedule is blocked (blockedReason): its destination or Plex server is disabled

200.description: Result (a failed delivery is ok: false)

put.summary: Update a notification; empty urls keep the stored ones
put.description: In stateless mode, changing apiUrl requires the Apprise URLs again (urls): stored URLs are only sent to the API they were saved with; otherwise 400.
